subject: Harden Zonoid memory-write protocol (backslash-safe, file-POST, verify response)
description: In the first real ls20 run the agent's /overlay/note writes silently failed for several turns because backslashes/newlines in its inline curl JSON body broke shell+JSON escaping. Harden the agent-facing protocol in bench/arc_agi3_zonoid/adapter.py zonoid_task_instructions: (1) specify a backslash-free single-line grid encoding (digits 0-9 per row, rows joined with '/' or '|'; never backslashes or literal newlines in JSON); (2) recommend POSTing the JSON body from a temp file via curl --data @file to avoid inline-quoting bugs; (3) tell the agent to CHECK the write response (ok + note id) and retry on failure rather than assume success. Verify: py_compile ok; --dry-run ok; instructions text contains the new guidance.
